description.value: Junior's Pub & Grill is a neighbourhood pub on the corner of Commercial Drive and Graveley in Vancouver's East Side, positioning itself as a welcoming community gathering spot. It features 11 HD big screens showing live sports including NFL, UFC, European soccer, and Canucks games. The pub also hosts regular events such as Friday live entertainment, Sunday karaoke, and fundraiser nights for local sports teams and charities.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 40m; stands (3 spaces) at 75m. Total: 5 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and detailed, confirming the address (1601 Commercial Drive, Vancouver, BC V5W 3J3), phone (604.428.5484), and that the business is actively operating as a pub and grill. Takeout is explicitly offered on the menu page ('For Takeout Orders Call: 604.428.5484'), and the fundraiser page notes veggie burgers are available. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or water refill appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM name is 'Junior's Pub' but the website consistently uses 'Junior's Pub & Grill Vancouver' as the full trade name.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible neighbourhood pub on Commercial Drive with an active website, confirmed contact details, and food and drink service relevant to touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Fundraiser page states: 'All of the burgers (either beef or veggie) will come with mayo, lettuce, tomato and onion on the bun.'

wow_evidence: neighbourhood pub on the corner of Commercial Drive and Graveley
